comment: // BUG: [CR-R02-runtime_ecs_commands_bundle_commit-0007] 旧组件返回的 Box 在本轮结束时析构若 panic，会跳过下方生命周期暂存标志恢复；调用方捕获后继续使用同一 World，后续观察者不分发。证据：begin_commit、下方恢复点与 observers.rs。
impact: The ordinary old Box is dropped before the explicit flag restore. Queue/World unwind cleanup resumes without restoring the flag, so later admitted component insertion stages its lifecycle events and does not invoke registered observers.
impact_or_question: The ordinary old Box is dropped before the explicit flag restore. Queue/World unwind cleanup resumes without restoring the flag, so later admitted component insertion stages its lifecycle events and does not invoke registered observers.
limits: Static admitted code path only, not an executed reproduction.
Requires a caller that catches the first unwind and chooses to reuse the same World; no claim about all existing caller policies.
Replacement and other unwound values do not panic during cleanup; double-panic abort is excluded from this exact path.
next_action: Product owner may reproduce this exact first-unwind path with a later lifecycle observer and inspect unwind-safe staging restoration. No business edit, executed fixture, or dynamic acceptance is supplied.
root_static_fixture_not_executed: World::empty starts with lifecycle staging false; spawn an admitted default entity and insert old T { panic_on_drop: true }.
T is an ordinary nonzero-sized Component with default Table storage; Drop panics only for the old value. U is a separate ordinary component with a registered Insert observer.
Queue Commands::insert(entity, T { panic_on_drop: false }); unchanged T membership selects the same-signature replace branch.
Wrap apply_deferred in catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe); the first and only panic is old T destruction at the replacement-loop iteration end.
Keep the same World after catching and insert U through the public typed API. trigger_component_lifecycle sees the leaked true flag and stages events, leaving the U observer counter unchanged.
